RESOLUTION.DESC:
[b]The Security Council,[/b]
[i]Recalling[/i] the international crisis of January and February 2026, initiated on January Twenty-Seventh – a global outage which brought the physical world to a freeze. This disaster blocked national leaders from attending to national duties, ranging from addressing pressing issues to making their national voice heard in the World Assembly,
[i]Horrified[/i] at the origins of this outage being an egregious flaw in the fabric that binds the multiverse together – one which ought to have been resolved by the higher powers in light of prior incidents,
[i]Dismayed[/i] by the initial boredom that overtook national leaders after the first Bloody Twenty-Seventh, the onset of a calamity that ultimately lasted longer than the Holiday Apocalypse of 2022,
[i]Subsequently inspired[/i] by the means through which national leaders came together in the midst of this crisis, continuing to engage in international cultural festivities such as the January 2026 World Tour, hosted during the height of tank battling,
[i]Reflecting[/i] on how national leaders were advised to change the security credentials to their often-luxurious offices through which they rule their nation, albeit grateful that the fabric of the universe was rearranged to facilitate the restoration of national credentials to all their rightful holders,
[i]Pleased[/i] by the ultimate resolution of this international crisis on February Seventh, after the world stood still for ten days – resulting in national leaders flocking back to their offices, once again enjoying the comforts and struggles alike of the multiverse,
[i]Believing[/i] the world had left the chaos of this crisis behind as affairs returned to normality, until one day that started like all others in March – a day that would go down in infamy for the losses it inflicted upon the international community,
[i]Shocked[/i] that on the day of March Twenty-Seventh, which would come to be known as “Bloody Friday,” the world once again found itself torn asunder, after the sudden, devastating loss of over two thousand World Assembly members, a harrowing twelve percent of all members, left the international community in turmoil,
[i]Remembering[/i] the stark losses inflicted upon regions, through which multiple large regions lost an astounding fifteen percent of their World Assembly populations, further exemplifying the havoc that was wrecked across the multiverse,
[i]Horrified[/i] that World Assembly members were not the only nations affected by Bloody Friday, with over 40,100 total nations being lost within the confusion and destruction of this apocalypse, only furthering the damage across every plane of existence,
[i]Appalled[/i] alongside national leaders, who watched as humongous amounts of nations were destroyed among the detrimental losses of Bloody Friday, leaving leaders to comment on future impacts to the international community’s dynamics,
[i]Thankful[/i] that this catastrophe now resides in the past as one of many footnotes in the ledgers of international history, as one of several disasters of note that affected the multiverse,
[i]Inspired[/i] by the international community’s ability to persevere through times of global turmoil and uncertainty, and thus seeking to record this multiversal calamity in the halls of the Security Council,
[i]Thus, enshrines[/i] “The Bloody Twenty-Sevenths” into the Security Council on the merits of how it not only threw the world into chaos twice, but also cast tens of thousands of nations and societies into the abyss, many of which were never to be seen again.
RESOLUTION.NAME: The Bloody Twenty-Sevenths
